camel_example: aliyun bssopenapi QueryBill --region cn-hangzhou --SubscriptionType Subscription --BillingCycle '2018-07' --Type SubscriptionOrder --PageNum 1 --PageSize 20 --ProductCode rds --IsHideZeroCharge true --ProductType rds --BillOwnerId 123
description_en: Queries the settlement bills for an account in a specified billing cycle
description_zh: 查询用户某个账期内的结算账单
kebab_example: aliyun bssopenapi query-bill --billing-cycle 2018-07 --type SubscriptionOrder --product-code rds --product-type rds --subscription-type Subscription --is-hide-zero-charge true --page-num 1 --page-size 20 --bill-owner-id 123 --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryBill

parameters.help_en: The billing cycle. The format is YYYY-MM
parameters.name: billing_cycle

parameters.help_en:
The type. Valid values:

- SubscriptionOrder

- PayAsYouGoBill

- Refund

- Adjustment
parameters.help_zh:
类型。取值：
- SubscriptionOrder
- PayAsYouGoBill
- Refund
- Adjustment
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The subscription type. Valid values:

- Subscription

- PayAsYouGo

> This parameter must be used with the ProductCode parameter
parameters.help_zh:
订阅类型。取值：
- Subscription
- PayAsYouGo

> 必须和ProductCode参数一起使用
parameters.name: subscription_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to exclude bills with a pretax gross amount (PretaxGrossAmount) of 0. The default value is false. This ensures backward compatibility.

- true: Yes.

- false: No
parameters.help_zh:
根据原价（PretaxGrossAmount）是否为0做过滤，默认为否（兼容现有逻辑）。
- true：是。
- false：否
parameters.name: is_hide_zero_charge

parameters.help_en: The page number. The default value is 1
parameters.name: page_num

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 300
parameters.help_zh: 每页数量，默认值：20，最大值：300
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the account that owns the resource. This is the account that actually uses the resource
parameters.help_zh: 资源归属账号的ID，资源归属账号是实际使用资源的账号
parameters.name: bill_owner_id
